scope: Read-only inspection of the new root-level GLB; no Blender scene or model changes were made.
inspectionMethod: Parsed original GLB mesh, UV and embedded PNG; produced CPU z-buffer orthographic unlit projections. These are diagnostic projections, not final Blender validation renders.

mesh.coordinateSystem: Original glTF coordinates, Y up. Visual inspection confirms positive Z is front.

preserve: Overall original T-pose, blouse torso contour, shoulder/sleeve volume, cuff positions and waist height.
Dark green skirt silhouette, length and the visible major vertical pleat rhythm. Do not globally smooth or voxel-remesh.
Leg lengths, white sock heights and brown shoe overall volumes, pending neutral-lit verification.
Original garment UV data and texture wherever no repair is needed; no unconditional re-unwrap or resolution increase.

observedIssues.evidence: Dark irregular shapes appear on both sides of the collar in the Z+ view.
observedIssues.interpretation: Could include both hair fused to the shirt and texture contamination; needs material/geometry inspection before removal.
observedIssues.action: Separate hair replacement from retained garment, then repair actual contaminated garment texels only. Do not erase dark pixels globally.

observedIssues.evidence: A centre placket and button pattern similar to the front is visible in the Z- view.
observedIssues.interpretation: Confirmed texture leakage against the actual four-view design sheet: back has a continuous blouse panel with no button placket.
observedIssues.action: Locally repaint the back centre and preserve the collar/shoulder gathering. Do not mirror front buttons onto the back.

observedIssues.evidence: Small pale flecks and discontinuous-looking border marks are visible.
observedIssues.interpretation: The unlit diagnostic alone does not distinguish every texture artifact from geometry damage.
observedIssues.action: Check local boundary/non-manifold results and neutral material view. Fix actual edges locally, then repair local colour; preserve pleat ridges.

observedIssues.evidence: Strong narrow warm/dark baked colour lines are visible, particularly at the side silhouette.
observedIssues.interpretation: Directional shading or image seam baked into the colour image, not evidence of physical anatomy.
observedIssues.action: Repaint affected skin regions to a quiet anime palette; keep authored knee cues subtle. No pores or realistic skin noise.

observedIssues.region: Cuffs, sock tops and shoe borders
observedIssues.evidence: Contours are mostly readable in unlit projections; local edge quality remains unresolved.
observedIssues.action: Inspect neutral close-ups after head and hand replacement. Keep reasonable garment openings open; do not close all boundaries indiscriminately.

approximateOriginalCoordinateBands.note: Only rough selection guides from the original glTF; NOT safe cut planes. Boundaries must be established on actual surface connectivity and current transforms.

repairOrder: Retain original correct body/garment geometry while the face, hands and hair are reconstructed independently.
After integration, use the original UV texture and spatial/face-normal masks to identify specific garment colour contamination.
Repair only confirmed damaged boundary edges or fragments; avoid global merge/remesh/smoothing.
Apply local colour repair/baking with surface-visibility masks, not unmasked front projection.
Verify full front, side, back and quarter with the same neutral Blender camera/light setup before and after.
Check exported GLB after clean re-import; a successful mesh export alone is not appearance acceptance.
limitations: No new model was authored or saved by this audit.
No Blender material/light validation, self-intersection test or geometric four-view registration was performed by this task.
No old rejected character geometry was reused.
No claim that clothing repair or final delivery is complete.
referenceNotes: Actual four-view design sheet visually inspected. It uses arms-down poses; retain the input model T-pose as explicitly requested.
Back blouse has no button placket. Rear repeated buttons on the GLB are confirmed wrong.
Above-knee dark green skirt with broad major pleats; white socks reach middle/lower shin. Overall input lengths are suitable starting points.
